_comment: Season aliases, written against the 11 distinct values Items.season actually
Two things worth knowing before editing:
1. An empty season is the most common value by far (725 of 1154 items). It means
'not seasonal' — tools, furniture, cooked dishes — NOT 'unknown'. It resolves
to all four seasons, because such an item is obtainable whenever.
2. Two values in this column are not seasons at all but festival date ranges:
'Fall 7 to 10' (Queen Berry) and 'Spring 14 to 16' (Breath of Spring). They
become an availability window's `dates`, not its `seasons`. The resolver
parses them by pattern rather than by alias, so a new festival window works
